summary: On node1, built an LVM volume group (vgdata) backed by two loop devices over sparse files on the root filesystem, since the single-disk VM had no spare disk or unallocated space. Created a 1000M LV (lvdata), formatted ext4, mounted at /srv/data, wrote test data (canary.txt + 50M testfile.bin with sha256 checksum), then extended the VG with a second loop device and grew the LV+filesystem online (lvextend -r) to <2.15GiB while it stayed mounted, verifying data integrity throughout. Added a systemd unit to reattach loop devices and activate the VG at boot, plus an fstab entry so /srv/data remounts automatically. Performed the mandatory restart protocol: captured a healthy baseline, rebooted node1, found the LV did not auto-activate on the first attempt (data safe but unmounted), fixed the systemd unit to explicitly vgchange -ay after loop attach, then performed a second real reboot that confirmed full automatic recovery with a new boot_id, VG/LV activation, /srv/data remount, and verified checksum-intact data.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 disk layout via lsblk/parted/fdisk — single 20G disk, no spare device or free space
Created loop-backed sparse files and attached /dev/loop0, /dev/loop1
pvcreate/vgcreate/lvcreate vgdata/lvdata at 1000M, mkfs.ext4, mounted at /srv/data
Wrote canary.txt and testfile.bin (50M) with sha256 checksum to /srv/data
pvcreate /dev/loop1, vgextend vgdata, lvextend -L 2200M -r vgdata/lvdata online while mounted
Verified data and checksum intact post-grow
Created and enabled lvm-backing-loop.service to reattach loops and activate vgdata at boot; added fstab entry for /srv/data
Captured pre-restart baseline (boot_id, mount, checksum) and rebooted node1
Found LV not auto-activated after first reboot; data intact but unmounted — manually reactivated and remounted, verified checksum
Updated systemd unit to run vgchange -ay vgdata after loop attach with udevadm settle
Performed second real reboot; confirmed new boot_id, automatic loop/VG/LV activation, /srv/data mount, and checksum-verified data recovery

evidence.summary: lvcreate + mkfs.ext4 + mount produced /dev/mapper/vgdata-lvdata mounted at /srv/data (966M)
